# The implement step reports no skill call. The item stops, and the text names how to start it again.
! exec beehave run 7 --workflow flow/workflow.star
stderr 'did not call the skill'
stderr 'beehave resume 7, then beehave cancel 7, then beehave run 7'
grep -count=1 '^implement ' calls.log

exec beehave status
stdout '^item-7-r1\tfailed'

# The resume replays the recorded implement step, so the stop comes again and the agent does not run a second time.
exec beehave resume 7
! exec beehave run 7 --workflow flow/workflow.star
stderr 'did not call the skill'
grep -count=1 '^implement ' calls.log

# The cancel ends the failed run, and the item then starts again as a new run.
exec beehave cancel 7
exec beehave status
stdout '^item-7-r1\tcancelled'
rm no-skill
exec beehave run 7 --workflow flow/workflow.star
exec beehave status
stdout 'item-7-r2'
grep -count=2 '^implement ' calls.log

-- no-skill --
-- verdicts --
approve
approve
approve
-- expected-events.log --
